line: Every man in Seriphos brought a horse for my wedding.
I am a fisherman's son. I have nothing to give.
Nothing. Then why do you stand in my hall?
Because you want my mother. And she refused you.
She will accept when her son is gone.
delivery: Quiet menace, a smile in the voice

line: No. No one returns from her. You know that.
Or are the sons of Zeus liars?
Shh. Shh. Your grandfather sealed us in this chest.
The sea will not take us.
Your father is a god. One day, he will come for us.
And then he'll never touch you.
I don't want her head. I want my son.
Your sister. Athena. Our father sent me.
Take this shield. Never look at her.
And this blade. It cuts what nothing else can.
Why help me? What is she to you?
And for that she must die?
For that, she must never be spoken of again.
Who's there? Who took our eye? Give it back!
Thief! Three sisters, one eye, and you rob the blind?
West. Past the stones that were men.
Look at them. Fishermen. Soldiers. Kings.
They all came to make a name. Now they have none.
I'm not here for a name.
Your mother. I had sisters once.
A temple. A goddess. I prayed every night.
I never broke a single promise.
And when they came for me, she watched.
She punished me. Not him. Me.

delivery: Non-verbal: broken laugh turning to scream

line: Eyes on the shield. Eyes on the shield. Eyes on the shield.
Eyes on the shield. Eyes on the shield. Eyes on the shield.
Eyes on the shield. Eyes on the shield.
Eyes on the shield. Eyes on the shield.

delivery: Non-verbal: final scream, cut by [blade] SFX, then [silence]

line: Sister, wake up. Who did this? Who did this?
Show the whole hall what a fisherman's son can bring.
And now she will guard me forever.
Let every man who looks upon my shield
remember what happens to those who turn away.
